offer.title: Jabir the drover
offer.text: Two fat goats on a rope. Each has a crescent burned into its ear: the mark of Saeed, the herder from the river fields. Jabir grins. “Saeed won't miss two. Ten coins for both, and the butcher by the gate pays thirty.”

bought.title: Thirty coins
bought.text: You pay Jabir ten coins and lead the goats to the butcher, who pays thirty and asks nothing. Jabir winks: “More tomorrow.”

told.title: Saeed the herder
told.text: Saeed comes running with his stick and finds his goats tied at the gate. He grips your hand and will not let go. By evening Jabir is gone from the gate, and he does not come back.
